parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity for the query. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- **60**: 1 minute.

- **1800**: 30 minutes.

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT Gateway.

parameters.name: SrcPublicIP
parameters.description: The source IP address on the Internet.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
